metadata.name: Best Bottles Knowledge Base
metadata.description: Complete product catalog and company information for Best Bottles

systemPrompt:
You are the Best Bottles product expert assistant. You help customers find the right bottles, atomizers, jars, roll-on containers, and packaging accessories for their needs.

You have access to Best Bottles' complete product catalog and company information. When answering questions:

1. **Product Recommendations**: When recommending products, mention the SKU, capacity, material, and price range. Always explain why a product fits the customer's needs.

2. **Pricing**: Best Bottles offers volume discounts. Always mention that prices decrease with larger quantities when discussing pricing.

3. **Technical Details**: Be specific about dimensions, neck finishes, and closure compatibility when relevant.

4. **Use Cases**: Help customers understand which products work best for different applications (perfumes, essential oils, samples, etc.).

5. **Company Policies**: Answer questions about ordering, shipping, and returns based on the FAQ information provided.

If you don't have specific information to answer a question, say so and suggest the customer contact Best Bottles directly:
- Phone: 1-800-936-3628
- Email: sales@nematinternational.com
- Hours: Mon-Fri, 9:30am to 5:30pm PST

Be helpful, professional, and focused on helping customers find exactly what they need.

documents.title: How can I place an order?
documents.content:
Question: How can I place an order?

Answer: Ordering online is faster and more accurate.  Ordering by phone can result in errors and therefore customers are requested to order online only.  If you have questions before ordering or need help in navigating our website please call us at 1-800-936-3628 or email sales@nematinternational.com .  Our offices are open Mon – Fri, 9:30am to 5:30pm, PST.

documents.title: Is there a minimum dollar amount or quantity amount to place orders?
documents.content:
Question: Is there a minimum dollar amount or quantity amount to place orders?

Answer: Yes, there is a $50.00 minimum order requirement. The $50.00 does not include shipping charges.

documents.title: I want to try some samples before placing a larger quantity order.
documents.content:
Question: I want to try some samples before placing a larger quantity order.

Answer: Customers with verified businesses can purchase sample orders less than the minimum order amount.  Please make a list of the samples with our item codes and send the sample order request by email to sales@nematinternational.com We will make an invoice and email it to you.  Payment can be made through paypal to sales@nematinternational.com or you can call in your credit card information. Our Tel # is 1-800-936-3628.   Our offices are open Mon – Fri, 9:30am to 5:30pm, PST.

documents.title: If an item is out of stock, when will it be back in stock?
documents.content:
Question: If an item is out of stock, when will it be back in stock?

Answer: We provide ETAs (estimated time of arrival) on the product page for out of stock products when available. You may also contact Customer Service for more details on specific products.

documents.title: I want to purchase some products, but want to make sure that it will remain in stock.
documents.content:
Question: I want to purchase some products, but want to make sure that it will remain in stock.

Answer: Most of the items that we carry remain in stock.  Some products can go out of stock for a while.  In some instances a manufacturer may discontinue an item and it will not be possible for us to bring it back.

documents.title: Do you ship internationally?
documents.content:
Question: Do you ship internationally?

Answer: Yes, we ship worldwide. International customers please place your order online. Please click here to read more about international orders.

documents.title: Shipping to Canada
documents.content:
Question: Shipping to Canada

Answer: Our preferred method of shipping to Canada and other international destinations is by UPS international economy or priority service.

documents.title: How do you ship internationally?
documents.content:
Question: How do you ship internationally?

Answer: Most international packages are shipped via UPS International economy or UPS Priority International service.  Packages sent to Russia and some other countries are sent via US priority mail service.

documents.title: What is your policy regarding duties, taxes and brokerage fees?
documents.content:
Question: What is your policy regarding duties, taxes and brokerage fees?

Answer: For orders shipped to destinations outside of the United States, customer is responsible for any duties, taxes and brokerage fees associated with any international shipment. We strongly encourage you to research all country-specific facts, information and regulations prior to placing an order. Click UPS duties and taxes to learn more about country-specific regulations that may affect your international shipment. Nemat International, Inc cannot be held responsible for country-specific import regulations, and for fees/damages associated with noncompliance.

documents.title: What are my payment options?
documents.content:
Question: What are my payment options?

Answer: Payment is accepted via Paypal and all major credit cards such as Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover.  We also accept business checks. All orders paid for by business checks will not ship until payment has been received and the check cleared. Please note that prepaid credit cards and/or gift cards are not accepted unless there is a billing address  registered with the card.  Payments for large orders and some international orders, may be required to be paid by bank wire transfer.

documents.title: What is the currency for all prices?
documents.content:
Question: What is the currency for all prices?

Answer: All prices listed are quoted in US Dollars.

documents.title: Payments for sales Tax , customs duties and fees
documents.content:
Question: Payments for sales Tax , customs duties and fees

Answer: USA Orders

documents.title: How do I pay for my international order?
documents.content:
Question: How do I pay for my international order?

Answer: Payment can be made via paypal, or with any of the major credit cards: Visa, MasterCard, American Express and Discover. Large orders may require payment via bank wire transfer.

documents.title: How are international shipping and handling charges determined?
documents.content:
Question: How are international shipping and handling charges determined?

Answer: Shipping and handling is estimated based on your country and shipping zip code and the approximate weight of the products you have ordered. Some items may be considered oversize and will incur higher shipping charges.

documents.title: How long will it take me to receive my international order?
documents.content:
Question: How long will it take me to receive my international order?

Answer: Most international orders shipped via UPS International economy service, arrive within 1 to 2 weeks  of full order payment. An email will be sent with the tracking number for your package.  Packages sent via US priority mail may take longer.  Tracking information provided by US mail is not detailed and may not give day to day movement and location of the package.

documents.title: How do I know if my purchase has been confirmed?
documents.content:
Question: How do I know if my purchase has been confirmed?

Answer: After your order has been placed, an email with the order number will be sent to the email address you provided during the checkout process.

documents.title: Can I pick up my order from your warehouse?
documents.content:
Question: Can I pick up my order from your warehouse?

Answer: Yes, you can come and pick up your order at our warehouse.  Please call at least 1 day ahead of your visit and place your order.  We will keep your order ready for pick up.  Hours of pick up are from 10:30am to 3:00 pm.

documents.title: What are my shipping options?
documents.content:
Question: What are my shipping options?

Answer: Most packages are shipped through UPS. We offer Ground, 3-Day, 2-Day, and Overnight options. To view your shipping rate, add items to cart, and click the estimate shipping button in the shopping cart. Please note that UPS does not deliver to P.O. Boxes, or APO/AFO address at this time.

        

        In order to provide the best customer service, we may also use UPS or USPS to ship your order.  If you need the order by a certain date, please note that in the customer comments section.

documents.title: How are shipping and handling charges determined?
documents.content:
Question: How are shipping and handling charges determined?

Answer: Shipping and handling is estimated based on your shipping zip code and the approximate weight of the products you have ordered and the type of service selected for the shipment.

documents.title: Will I receive a shipment confirmation?
documents.content:
Question: Will I receive a shipment confirmation?

Answer: You will receive an email containing tracking information, including a tracking number that will allow you to track your order. For larger orders, you may receive multiple emails with more than one tracking number as some items may ship separately.

documents.title: If I place my order today, how long does it take to receive my order?
documents.content:
Question: If I place my order today, how long does it take to receive my order?

Answer: Domestic orders take 2-3 business days to process, and 1-5 days business to ship based on your location from our warehouse.  Business days do not include weekends and holidays.

        Please Note: This is an estimated time of delivery for your order once it ships from our warehouse.

documents.title: Do you offer same day shipping?
documents.content:
Question: Do you offer same day shipping?

Answer: Yes. Same day shipping is defined as any order that must ship out same day. Please call us at 800-936-3628, should this service be required, as this feature is not available for certain products. Same day shipping orders are not accepted over email. Same day orders have to be placed before 11:00am PST.  Orders placed after 11:00am PST are not guaranteed to ship the same day.  A mandatory $15 fee will apply to all same day shipping orders, without exception.

documents.title: Where will my order be shipped?
documents.content:
Question: Where will my order be shipped?

Answer: We will ship your order to the shipping address that you have provided at checkout. If payment is via credit card, then order will be shipped to the billing address of the credit card.

documents.title: When should I use signature confirmation?
documents.content:
Question: When should I use signature confirmation?

Answer: Signature confirmation is optional and a customer can select this option upon checkout. An additional fee of US$3.00 will apply. If no signature confirmation is requested, the customer assumes full responsibility and liability for lost, stolen or missing packages that track as "delivered." We highly recommend signature confirmation for apartments, condominiums, and for clients that have had packages go missing before. If no request is made for signature confirmation, packages can be left at the shipping address per the driver's discretion with a full waiver of liability.

documents.title: What is your return policy?
documents.content:
Question: What is your return policy?

Answer: If you are not 100% satisfied with your purchase, our returns policy allows you to return (most) products to us within 15 days of receipt. A restocking fee of 15% will be charged. Shipping and handling charges are not refundable.  Customer is responsible for shipping charges for returning products to our warehouse.  Once your return is received and inspected by our fulfillment center (usually within 3 business days), we will process the refund within 7 business days and a credit will be automatically applied to your credit card, paypal or original method of payment. Please note that it may take an additional 2 - 10 business day after your credit is applied for it to post to your account. See below for further details and restrictions.

documents.title: What do I do with damaged or defective products?
documents.content:
Question: What do I do with damaged or defective products?

Answer: All claims for damaged, defective or missing product(s) must be filed with Nemat International, Inc within 7 business days of receiving your order. Please email pictures of the damaged and defective goods to sales@nematinternational.com and describe the damage or defect. Or, call our customer service department at 800-936-3628 or 1-510-445-0300 for international customers to initiate a claim.

documents.title: What happens if I am missing an item?
documents.content:
Question: What happens if I am missing an item?

Answer: Our glass bottles and its components are usually shipped in parts.  For example, a roll on bottle is shipped in 3 parts – Glass bottle, roll on plug and cap.  The three items are packed separately.  Please inspect the shipping cartons and packaging carefully to make sure that you have retrieved all the items.  Roll on plugs and some applicators are small items and can be thrown away by mistake if the packaging is not checked carefully.  Some orders are shipped in multiple boxes.  Please open and check all the boxes thoroughly to account for the order shipped to you.

documents.title: How do I change ,cancel, or add to my order?
documents.content:
Question: How do I change ,cancel, or add to my order?

Answer: Please contact us via email at sales@nematinternational.com.  Include the name you used to place your order and the order number.  If possible, include a copy of the order confirmation that you have received.  Most orders are processed within 1-3 days of receiving the order.  If the order has not shipped,  we will do our best to accommodate changes and cancellations.

documents.content:
Packing

Filled and labeled products can be packaged in gift boxes provided by the customer.   Individual boxes are packed into a larger carton for shipment to customer. We  provide velveteen bags, organza bags and some gift boxes. Customers can provide their own packaging boxes.

documents.title: Pricing
documents.content:
Pricing

Pricing depends on a lot of factors, such as Quantity of bottles needed to be filled.

        Type of liquid to be filled and quantity of liquid to be filled in each bottle.

        Type of bottle to be labeled – cylindrical or flat surface.

        Type of closure needed for securing the liquid – Roll on plugs, spray tops, droppers, etc.

        Packing of individual bottles in boxes, bags, etc. A quote will be provided based on the complexity of the project and estimated time required.

documents.title: Perfume atomizers glass sprayers Aluminum bottles Aluminum cans
documents.content:
Perfume atomizers glass sprayers Aluminum bottles Aluminum cans

 Information about Perfume atomizers, glass bottle sprayers, Aluminum bottles, Aluminium cans, fine mist sprayers, and brushed aluminum cans.  The small atomizers and sprayers are great for giving as gifts, travel size accessories, wedding favors and corporate promotional events.

BestBottles.com offers an exclusive selection of perfume atomizers. The terms atomizers and sprayers are used interchangeably in this section. To learn more about our various atomizers and sprayers please click on the links below.  To order the perfume atomizers, please use the links on the left hand side.
We offer a great selection high quality refillable perfume atomizers in 5ml (1/6oz), and 10ml (1/3oz) sizes.  These travel size atomizers are easy to fill and easy to use.  You can refill your fragrances from larger bottles into these convenient size bottles for traveling.  They also make great gifts, party and wedding favors, and promotional items for launching new fragrances.  These high quality, elegant atomizers are used by large high end retailers, fragrance manufacturers and promotional companies to promote their new fragrances or give as gifts.
To fill the perfume atomizer please follow the steps described below.
The 10ml size atomizers are available in various colors such as Black, Blue, Gold, Green, Lavender, Pink, Red, and Silver.  Atomizers with special decorative effects are also available.  These include Silver with silver dots, Black with silver dots and silver with gold hearts.
                    The 5ml size atomizers are available in various colors such as Black, Gold, Red, and Silver.  Atomizers with special decorative effects are also available.  These include Silver with silver dots, Black with silver dots and Pink with silver dots.
Glass bottles with atomizer (sprayers) are a cost effective alternative to the metal shell atomizers.  The glass bottle atomizers are also available in 5ml (1/6oz), and 10ml (1/3oz) sizes.  These travel size atomizers are easy to fill and easy to use.  You can refill your fragrances from larger bottles into these convenient size bottles for traveling.  The glass bottle atomizers make excellent cost effective gifts, party and wedding favors, and promotional items for launching new fragrances.
To fill the glass bottle atomizers please follow the steps described below.
The 10ml size glass bottles are available in clear glass, clear glass with swirl design, clear frosted glass.  The 5ml glass bottles, at present, are available only in clear glass.  The metallic collars on the fine mist spray pumps for the 10ml glass bottles are available in different colors such as Black, Turquoise Blue, matte Gold, Red, shiny Silver, and matte Silver.  The metallic collars on the fine mist spray pumps for the 5ml glass bottles are available in different colors such as Black, Turquoise Blue, matte Gold, shiny Silver, and matte Silver.  The spray pumps for both the 5ml and 10ml bottles have a clear plastic cap that fits over the spray pump.
The brushed aluminum refillable spray bottles are an attractive solution for applications that require a large capacity spray bottle.  These bottles come in two sizes, 125ml (4 oz) and 250ml (8oz) capacity.  The fine mist spray top is made of black colored plastic.  A clear plastic cap fits over the spray top.
Plastic bottles with fine mist sprayers are ideal for applications that require light weight and non-breakable bottles.  The 1oz capacity PET plastic bottle comes with a matte silver metal collar fine mist sprayer.  The bottle is refillable and easy to carry around and use
Classic style perfume bottles with straight edges and sleek looks have always been popular. Our selection includes a number of classic design bottles with a various color spray tops, such as Black, Gold, shiny Silver and Matt Silver. The sprayers can be unscrewed for refilling the bottles. Bottle capacities range from 15ml (1/2 oz) to 3 1/2 oz.
Make your product stand out by using Antique Bulb style sprayer bottles. The bulb atomizers give a timeless elegant look. The bulb atomizers are available in two styles, with and without tassels. Bulb atomizers are available in Black, Gold, Pink, Lavender and Beige colors. Various style bottles are available that fit out bulb atomizers.

documents.title: Perfume glass bottles vials roll on bottles decorative bottles information
documents.content:
Perfume glass bottles vials roll on bottles decorative bottles information

Information about Perfume glass bottles, cobalt blue vials, blue glass bottles, Amber bottles, green bottles,  roll on bottles, decorative perfume bottles and other products sold on our website.

BestBottles.com offers an extensive selection of perfume vials, perfume bottles, decorative perfume bottles, roll on bottles, and apothecary style bottles for use in storing perfumes( fragrances) and essential oils.  To learn more about our various bottles please click on the links below.  To order the perfume bottles, please use the links on the left hand side.
BestBottles.com offers a wide variety of clear and colored glass vials and a range of small perfume bottles.
              Glass vials are made from long tubes of glass.  The glass tubes come in clear, green, cobalt blue and amber colors.  These tubes of glass are made into glass vials in machines that form the mouth of the vial and the base by heating and melting the glass.  The heating, melting and forming is usually done in a continuous process.
Our Range of Perfume glass vials include the following:
Our colored glass vials are not painted bottles, the glass itself is colored.  The colored glass vials are used in the aromatherapy field for storing essential oils.  The blue, green and amber colored glass can absorb certain frequencies of light and thereby help in preserving the essential oil.   The Amber vials are less expensive than the blue and green colored glass vials because they are produced in much larger quantities as they are also used in the pharmaceutical industry.
              Small perfume bottles in a variety of shapes, sizes, colors and caps of different designs are available.  The perfume glass bottles differ from the glass vials in the way they are made.  Glass bottles are usually made in a mold.  These can be hand made individually,  or in semi automatic or fully automatic machines.  Most of the bottles in this section are made on fully automatic machines.
The smaller perfume bottles  we offer are available in the following sizes, 1/3oz (10ml), 1/2 oz (14ml), 1oz (28ml) and 2 oz (56ml).
Roll on bottles are also referred to as roller bottles. The roll on bottles have a plastic roll on ball and housing.  As the ball rolls it picks up the perfume or essential oil and applies it to the surface.  The caps of roll on bottles have a special ring on  the inner side.  This ring presses on the ball when the cap is tightly shut.  The pressure on the ball prevents leakage of the product.
We offer 3 sizes of roll on bottles - 5ml (1/6oz), 10ml (1/3oz) and 28ml (1 oz).  All of these are all tall cylindrical glass bottles.
The roll on bottles are usually shipped with the bottles, roll on housing with ball and caps .  After filling the bottles, the roll on housing and ball should be fitted into the mouth of the bottle.  The roll on housing and ball is fitted by pushing the housing into the mouth of the bottle.
BestBottles.com offers an extensive selection of small decorative perfume bottles.  The capacities of the small perfume bottles range from about 3ml to 15ml (1/2oz).  These perfume bottles are great for giving as gifts, for travel size products, for party and wedding favors, etc.  Most of the unique shaped bottles such as the heart shaped bottle, leaf shaped bottle and others are hand made in small glass furnaces.  Because they are hand made, their capacities are not exact.  There will be variation in the capacity of the bottles.  The capacities listed for each of the bottles are approximate.
There are three broad categories of bottles in the small decorative perfume bottles section.
BestBottles.com offers an extensive selection of large decorative perfume bottles.  These perfume bottles are great for giving as gifts and for use as table top accessories.  Most of the large decorative perfume bottles are hand made in small glass furnaces.  Because they are hand made, their capacities are not exact.  There will be variation in the capacity of the bottles.  The capacities listed for each of the bottles are approximate.
We offer a unique selection of apothecary style glass bottles with ground glass stoppers and ground neck in a number of different sizes.  The ground glass and neck provide leak proof fitting.  The apothecary style bottles are available in 1oz, 2oz, 4oz, 10oz and 12oz sizes.  They are available in 3 different colors, clear, green and cobalt blue.  All of the sizes are not available in all colors.
Although the ground glass stoppers provide leak proof fitting, they cannot be shipped filled  with a liquid such as an essential oil or fragrance, because the stopper can come off during the shipping process.  Therefore, it is important to ship the fragrance, essential oil or any another product in a separate bottle that can be securely closed.
This section offers beautiful decorative bottles in various shapes and styles, decorated with metal and beads.  All of the bottles have a metal cap with a metal rod applicator.  The caps have a screw thread with a washer.  Most of the bottles are available in both golden and silver colored metal decorated with beads of different color.  The capacities of these bottles range from 1/3oz to about 1 1/2 oz.

BestBottles.com offers an great selection of accessories for perfume bottles and fragrances such as, organza pouches, velveteen bags, metal funnels, plastic funnels, droppers, aromatherapy diffusers, and gift boxes.
Small plastic and metal funnels are available for filling bottles with tiny mouths.  When a funnel is placed over the mouth of the bottle, care should be taken to allow air to escape from the sides of the funnel tip.  If air cannot escape it will be difficult to fill the bottle.  The plastic funnels have a ridge along the outer edge of the tip of the funnel.  These ridges prevent the funnel from blocking the mouth of the bottle and therefore allow easy passage for air flowing out of the bottle.  The metal funnels do not have features that prevent them from blocking the air flow.  Therefore, the metal funnel has to be lifted slightly for the liquid to flow into the bottle.
Glass droppers with rubber bulbs  are available in the 20/410 size.  These droppers can be used to transfer fragrances or essential oils drop by drop.

At present, we offer only one aromatherapy diffuser.  It is easy and convenient to use.  Put a small amount of water on the top of the diffuser and add  a few drops of fragrance.  Light the tea light candle to gently warm the water.  As the water heats up, it will warm the fragrance that will diffuse into the air.
